title.zh: 种群增长 · S 形曲线从哪来
title.en: Population Growth · Where the S-Curve Comes From

desc.zh: 没有天花板时种群按倍数狂奔，有了容纳量 K 就被压成 S 形：每一代的实际增长率由 r(1−N/K) 当场实算；把 r 推过安全区，还能亲眼看到离散模型振荡失效。
desc.en: With no ceiling a population multiplies wildly; with carrying capacity K it bends into an S. The effective rate r(1−N/K) is computed generation by generation — and if you push r past the safe zone, you can watch the discrete model oscillate and break.
